messages:
Maya (Marketing): Quick check — finalizing the partner webinar lineup for 'Cloud + Edge Showcase'. Need to lock speaker order, demo handoffs, AV needs, and swag flow. Can folks confirm by EOD tomorrow?
Asha (Partnerships): Confirmed. Please ask partners for a one-slide static fallback and a 60s recorded clip in case their live demo flops.
Tom (Partner PM): I'll ping CloudHarbor and ForgeLabs for fallback slides. Also: they want a 20-min integrator Q&A slot post-demo. Room available at 16:40. OK?
Maya (Marketing): Good. We should publish an RSVP for the integrator slot. I'll draft and send tomorrow AM.
Diego (Eng): Demo order suggestion to limit GPU warmups: 1) marketplace search (stateless), 2) on-device quantized clip (pre-warmed), 3) Dedicated cluster load demo (heavy). Also preparing a warmup job for Dedicated.
Sam (Events): AV note: need HDMI switcher, 2 lapel mics + 1 handheld spare, ethernet run to demo table. @Logistics Bot confirm adapter counts and spare batteries. Green room 20m before show.
Logistics Bot: Inventory: HDMI adapters x7, USB-C adapters x6, lapel mics x2, handhelds x2, spare batteries x18. Swag pallet TRK-33421 inbound Fri 07:15.
Tom (Partner PM): Swag rotation: morning stickers + postcards, afternoon tees + stickers, last hour promo cards only. Need volunteers per shift — Maya can you cover morning?
Maya (Marketing): I can cover 09:30-11:00. Will post signup. Also propose we limit tees to 1 per attendee.
Diego (Eng): Fallback curl snippet for partners if Dedicated throttles:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \\
  -d '{"model":"redwood-lite-quant","prompt":"<prompt>","max_tokens":64}'
```
Asha (Partnerships): Perfect. Diego, can you also produce a 90s pre-recorded clip for the on-device demo and drop into the shared drive by Wed 10:00?
Diego (Eng): Will do. Filename: ondevice_backup_v1.mp4.
Sam (Events): One more: venue network can be flaky. If VLAN is denied, we bring a local router and pre-seed models. Noted in runbook.
Maya (Marketing): I'll add the privacy sentence on the title slide: "Demo inputs use synthetic or anonymized data; no customer data is stored."
Asha (Partnerships): Great. Last ask: add unresolved items as comments in the shared runbook doc. Dry-run Thu 14:00please be in green room 20m early. Thanks! :thumbsup:
